source.downloaded_via: hf-mirror.com (direct huggingface.co unreachable from the build network)

device.name: Android Emulator emulator-5580 (arm64-v8a, SDK 35, software GPU)
device.backend: ONNX Runtime Android 1.22.0 ARM64, CPU EP (vision falls back from XNNPACK)

desktop_check.name: macOS x86_64, ONNX Runtime 1.22.0 JVM
desktop_check.notes: Synthetic 512x512 ARGB sheets; image_features [256,1024], text 35 tokens with marker positions [11,19,27], logits [1,3], all finite. These prove the IO contract and runnable kernels, not aesthetic quality.

bundle_profile: vision_encoder_fp16 + embed_tokens_quantized (Q4 block gather) + decision_q4 (4-bit MatMulNBits), all with external data

vision_encoder_fp16.inputs: pixel_values f32 [N,1024,768], pixel_attention_mask i64 [N,1024], spatial_shapes i64 [N,2]

decision_q4.inputs: inputs_embeds f32 [B,P+L,1024], attention_mask i64, prefix_len i64, marker_pos i64, marker_mask i64, qtype i64

q8_rejection.error: MatMulNBits '/trunk/conv/in_proj/MatMul_Q8': nbits_ == 4 was false. Only 4b quantization is supported for unpacked compute.
q8_rejection.root_cause: Exported nodes lack the accuracy_level=4 attribute; ORT 1.22 then selects SQNBIT_CompFp32 (unpacked), which implements 4-bit only. Reproduced on macOS x86_64 and Android arm64.
q8_rejection.resolution: Ship decision_q4.onnx; verified runnable on both platforms.

device_run.camera_preview: live emulator scene (ARCore-style room), LUMIX_MONO preset, realtime composition enabled

runs.note: Software-GPU emulator; queued behind the first run plus slow vision. App abstained and kept the rule overlay (model_outcome=TIMED_OUT), as designed.

output.contract: softmax over option marker logits (choice/noul/score); zero generated tokens; no coordinates
output.note: The earlier 384x384 score/problem_en/recommend_bbox JSON assumption was wrong; input is 512x512 SigLIP2 NaFlex and answers are marker probabilities. Geometry stays with FastCompositionAdvisor.

failure_behavior: Observed on device: a 30 s budget timeout returns null, the rule-based overlay and Chinese rule advice stay visible, and a 15 s cooldown applies. Session-load failure path remains code-only evidence.
open_items: Honor Vs3 real-device timing (vision 11.5 s and decision 4.5 s are software-emulator numbers, not representative of silicon)
permutation-consistency and positional-bias check on real contact sheets
independent labelled composition preference set; aesthetic quality is not established by these runs
memory under real camera contention on device
